title: Spectral determinants of flat metrics on the bielliptic genus-two locus
summary: We obtain a closed explicit formula for the spectral determinant of flat conical metrics on the bielliptic genus-two locus. The metrics are generated by holomorphic one-forms with two simple zeros. For a symmetric reference metric, an exact Klein-four spectral identity reduces the spectral determinant to scalar determinants on spheres and tori; the singular anomaly formula then yields the general case.
